title: Orange5 Compression Debt v0
description:
AtomSmasher Compression Debt Ledger entry. Each entry is a recorded admission that the system chose a verbose form when a compressed form was either possible or later discovered. Recording a debt is the honest move (Mom's Law: name the gap, don't hide it). Paying a debt is the recovery move — when re-execution or a later pass actually produces the compressed form, the debt closes and the realized savings are stamped on the row.

Entries are written to two substrates: (1) the Reality lane of Æ Cobra Flux as an append-only audit record (origin='atomsmasher', kind='compression-debt' or 'compression-debt-payment'); (2) a SQLite index for fast queries. Flux is canonical; SQLite is a projection that can be rebuilt by replay.

debt_id.description: SHA-256 hex digest uniquely identifying this debt. Computed over canonical-JSON of (verbose_hash, recorded_at, context.surface, context.actor). Identical verbose+context+timestamp pairs produce identical debt_ids; this lets the gateway dedupe accidental double-records.

verbose_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the verbose output the system chose. The hash is the receipt — the prose itself need not be stored on the row, only its fingerprint, so the ledger does not bloat with the very verbosity it is auditing.

verbose_chars.description: Character count of the verbose output. Honest measure of how much was written when less would have done.

compressed_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the compressed form, set when the debt is paid. Absent for open debts.

compressed_chars.description: Character count of the compressed form, set when the debt is paid. Absent for open debts.

savings_chars.description: verbose_chars - compressed_chars, computed at pay time. Negative savings are allowed but flagged in summary as 'regression' — the 'compressed' form was actually longer, which is itself a finding worth keeping.

status.description: Lifecycle. 'open' = debt recorded, not yet repaid. 'paid' = compressed form was produced and stamped. 'forgiven' = operator-marked write-off (e.g. the verbose form was actually load-bearing on inspection); rare, requires evidence.

recorded_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the debt was opened.

paid_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the debt was paid or forgiven. Absent for open debts.

context.description: Provenance: where the verbose choice was made.

surface.description: Coarse origin tag (e.g. 'air-codec', 'cartridge:legal', 'pathwave:plan', 'manual'). Free-form but should be stable per surface.

ref.description: Optional pointer to the source artifact (frame_id, receipt id, file path, etc).

reason.description: Optional short note on why the verbose form was chosen at the time (e.g. 'no codec for this surface yet', 'operator override', 'first-pass draft').

payment_evidence.description: Path/URI/hash pointing to the artifact that closed the debt — the receipt that the compressed form was actually produced. Required when status='paid' or 'forgiven'.
